status: outcome-blind structural preflight frozen before any numeric Height values
cohort_definition: Year × field_period from source columns. No cohort may be merged after Height is opened.
event_filter: rows with nonblank bat_id, trackid, utc, x, y and Height presence; Height magnitude is not parsed

primary_structure.target_support: target event cell appears in at least one other track of the same bat within cohort and in at least one track of another bat within cohort
primary_structure.individual_evaluable: at least one target track with >=50 supported events

mechanism_structure.state_interpretation: source HMM labels; undefined events excluded

persistence_1d.self_history: same bat tracks within cohort whose median UTC differs from target-track median UTC by >=1 day
persistence_1d.other_history: all tracks of other bats within cohort

structural_progression.state_5km_gate: proceed if >=70% of primary evaluable n and >=5 individuals
structural_progression.state_500m_gate: proceed if >=70% of state-5km evaluable n and >=5 individuals
structural_progression.persistence_1d_gate: proceed if >=70% of state-5km evaluable n and >=5 individuals

decision_rule: Freeze exact eligible IDs/n for every structurally passing stage before opening Height. A structurally failing stage is not rescued by changing grid, support, state labels, cohort or lag.
